paragraphs: Conflict requires thoughtful representation. When you need assistance with real estate disputes, Attorney Danielle Vaughn has the expertise and confidence to help you meet your goals.

Trial represents risk. It also requires financial investment and dedicated time. That is why we usually explore negotiation, arbitration, or mediation before moving on to litigation. We analyze the details of your case and will provide you with straightforward and honest opinions on your options to proceed. But when litigation is necessary, we represent our clients aggressively and strategically.
